notes: Covers the TK-3360 type K for 450-520 MHz, with KNB-55L/56N/57L packs.

gaps: The parts list prints the MCU as F3640MDFBKDKA; the semiconductor data page calls it R5F3640MDFB.
IC808 (HA1630D03MM) is also described as an AF amp, but the circuit description puts it in the 2-tone decode path, not the speaker path.
Battery conflict: the KNB-55L accessory page says 1480 mAh, while the specifications page writes 'With KNB-55L (1400mAh battery)'; Kenwood's US spec page also says 1480 mAh.
The antenna (KRA-27) is shown as an option on the manual's cover, so no antenna claim is made.
Kenwood's US spec page gives ALH415101 for the 400-470 MHz version; its column header misprints the model as TK-3260.
method: Main source: Kenwood TK-3360 service manual B51-8906-00 (printed 2010-1, 50 pages; Internet Archive copy), read as text from the PDF.
Every board part here is from the 450-520 MHz board.

Page refs: circuit description pp.9-13 (IC815 audio power amp p.10, drive and final amps p.11, X802 12 MHz MCU clock p.12), semiconductor data p.14, component descriptions p.16, parts list pp.18-24 (speaker, SMA receptacle and volume pot p.18; fuses and phone jacks p.20.
Coils, TCXO and crystal p.21; ICs, transistors, FETs and mic element p.23), battery packs p.45, specifications p.46.
Q205 RD07MUS2BT112 is the Mitsubishi RD07MUS2B (datasheet linked; the T112 suffix is not in its ordering list).
FCC: fccid.io lists ALH415100 as a Kenwood USA UHF FM transceiver, 450-512 MHz, 5 W, granted 2010-01-05, with a 'TK-3360 Instruction Manual' exhibit, which matches this 450-520 MHz version.
FCC exhibits were behind bot checks or access denied, so no FCC photo was used.

comps.spec: UHF FM transceiver, 450-520 MHz, max 16 channels, RF output 5 W / 1 W, operating voltage 7.5 V DC +/-20%
Final amp FET Q205 Mitsubishi RD07MUS2BT112; drive amp FET Q204 RFM01U7P
Q201 2SC5636 (pre-pre drive), Q203 2SC4926YD (pre drive), Q8/Q9 2SC5636 (RF buffer and RF amp)
IC809 microprocessor R5F3640MDFB (parts list number F3640MDFBKDKA)
IC815 TA7368FG, the audio power amplifier that drives the speaker; the radio's rated audio output is 500 mW at 8 ohm
X1 TCXO 16.8 MHz, Kenwood part L77-3050-05
X802 crystal resonator 12 MHz, Kenwood part L77-3049-05
Voltage regulators: IC801 and IC803 XC6209B502PR, IC802 XC6209B502MR (5 V); IC804 and IC806 XC6209B332MR (3.3 V)
RF coaxial receptacle (SMA) E04-0467-15 with antenna terminal assy E23-1345-04; J801 3.5 mm phone jack E11-0484-05, J802 2.5 mm phone jack E11-0715-05
Speaker, Kenwood part T07-0787-05; the radio's rated audio output is 500 mW at 8 ohm
MIC801 mic element, Kenwood part T91-0651-15
KNB-55L Li-ion pack 7.4 V (3.7 V x 2), 1480 mAh, with protection circuit; KNB-57L Li-ion 7.4 V 2000 mAh also listed
KNB-56N Ni-MH pack 7.2 V (1.2 V x 6), 1400 mAh
